lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines with relatively even spacing, spanning from the anterior shoulder to the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several line segments in the mid-ventral region and the anterior-most stripe terminate prematurely before reaching the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the upper thigh exhibit a semi-linear horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes, white patch on the lower throat, and distinct white markings on the lower limbs above the hooves.
